prompt:
Create ONE landscape location reference sheet of the SAME small, intimate modern
apartment living room shown in the reference image, seen from exactly FOUR camera
angles arranged as a clean 2 x 2 grid of four equal panels with thin even gaps,
no text, labels, numbers, arrows or watermark.
TOP LEFT: wide view from the entrance doorway on the left, looking into the room
(same viewpoint as the reference). TOP RIGHT: reverse wide view from beside the
TV wall on the right, looking back toward the L-shaped sofa, the amber lamp behind
it and the entrance. BOTTOM LEFT: view from the sofa toward the TV wall, the low
TV cabinet and the bookshelf. BOTTOM RIGHT: view from the window side looking
back into the room toward the entrance, with the night window behind the camera.

The room is EMPTY: no people, no animals, no figure in any panel. Preserve the
layout and furniture of the reference exactly and consistently in all four views:
open entrance on the left with a coat hook; dark grey L-shaped fabric sofa with
cushions and a knitted throw, left-centre; rectangular wooden coffee table at the
centre with a dark mug, a small bowl, a remote and a few books, lower shelf with
books; dark patterned rug on warm wooden parquet; small amber table lamp behind the
sofa on the left; large potted plant beside it; tall bookshelf with books and small
framed pictures on the right wall; flat TV on a low wooden cabinet on the right wall,
facing the sofa; floor-to-ceiling window with curtains at the back on a night city of
lit apartment towers. Same proportions and positions between panels.

Lighting identical to the reference: night, dominant dark olive/green ambience, the
TV as a cold greenish light on the right, the small warm amber lamp behind the sofa,
soft city glow from the window. Same graphic language: semi-anime illustration with
realistic proportions, fine visible contours, painterly faceted shadows, lightly
textured painted surfaces. Not a photograph, not a 3D render. Readable furniture
shapes, no extra rooms, no added furniture or objects, no family photos.
